# HEIC decoder

- Library: heic-to 1.5.2, unmodified IIFE distribution.
- Upstream source and build instructions: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
- Exact package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/heic-to/v/1.5.2
- Distribution source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/heic-to@1.5.2/dist/iife/heic-to.js
- License: LGPL-3.0; included in heic-to-LICENSE.txt. Upstream contains its libheif decoder source and notices.

The library is loaded as a separate, replaceable script only when a HEIC/HEIF file needs conversion. No modifications were made to the third-party distribution. All conversions run in the visitor's browser.
